title: Athena Enterprise Security Red Team & Purple Team Assessment Report
scope: Authentication, sessions, authorization and device trust
Sync V2, WebSocket, SSE and push notification control plane
AI Agent, tools, memory, knowledge base and vector retrieval
Collector, file processing, content-object storage and databases
iOS/iPadOS, Electron desktop, Docker, CI/CD and observability

modes: focused unit, integration and fault-injection tests
database, encryption, ledger, synchronization and supply-chain audits

assuranceBoundary: All active testing remained local, authorized and non-destructive.
No secret material was read into the report, printed, changed or rotated.
No external production system, third-party tenant or destructive payload was used.
PostgreSQL, NATS, S3/MinIO, KMS and multi-node behavior were reviewed through code and tests, not through an external production deployment.
Sync V2 is disabled in the current development runtime, so cohort behavior is not claimed as production-proven.
